title: Treesa Jolly-Gayatri Gopichand Advance to Syed Modi International Quarterfinals
indian_angle: Defending champions Treesa Jolly and Gayatri Gopichand continue their strong performance at a home international event.
summary: The Indian defending champions, Treesa Jolly and Gayatri Gopichand, secured their spot in the quarterfinals of the Syed Modi India International by defeating compatriots Shreya Balaji and Pranavi Natarajan 21-9, 21-8.

title: Tanvi, Anmol Progress in Syed Modi India International Singles
indian_angle: Indian shuttlers Tanvi and Anmol continue their campaigns in the singles categories at the ongoing Syed Modi India International.
summary: Indian shuttler Tanvi faced a tough challenge from Puspitasari but advanced, while Anmol eased past Ashmita in their respective matches at the Syed Modi India International.

title: New Delhi to Host Thomas and Uber Cup Finals in 2028
indian_angle: India has been awarded the hosting rights for the prestigious Thomas and Uber Cup Finals in 2028, marking a significant milestone for Indian badminton.
summary: New Delhi has been selected as the venue for the 2028 Thomas and Uber Cup Finals, a major international team championship, highlighting India's growing prominence in global badminton.

title: India Invited to Host Two Additional BWF International Challenge Events
indian_angle: India has received an invitation to host two more BWF Grade 3 International Challenge tournaments, providing additional opportunities for Indian players on home soil.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has received an invitation to host two additional BWF Grade 3 (International Challenge) tournaments during the 2027–2029 period, expanding India's international badminton calendar.

title: Badminton Association of India Elections Scheduled for December 26 in Guwahati
indian_angle: The Badminton Association of India will hold its forthcoming elections in Guwahati, shaping the future leadership of Indian badminton.
summary: The Badminton Association of India (BAI) has announced that its elections will take place on December 26, 2026, in Guwahati, determining the new office bearers for the national body.

title: Senior National Badminton Championships Set for December in Bhubaneswar
indian_angle: The 88th Senior National Badminton Championships, a crucial event for Indian shuttlers, will be held in Bhubaneswar, Odisha, in December.
summary: The Yonex-Sunrise 79th Inter State – Inter Zonal & 88th Senior National Badminton Championships 2026 are scheduled to be held in Bhubaneswar, Odisha, from December 17th to 24th, 2026.
